title: Plate modal analysis app
line: Pick a mode of a simply supported plate and see its 3-D shape.
description: An app for a 600 by 400 by 5 mm aluminum plate: a pop-up menu picks one of the first eight modes, the 3-D surface and contour plot show its shape, and a table of TeX labels lists the natural frequencies.
thumbnailAlt: An app window with a model summary, a mode menu and a frequency table beside a 3-D mode shape of a plate and its contour plot, rendered by RunMat
